entries.text: Made high-grade titanium washer out of Pim (a strip of hull plating) and Tok (a mystery box that hums) and named it Mabel.

He invented a new part: high-grade titanium washer! i'll trim the hull plating into a ring and use the hum from the mystery box to heat-treat it until it's hardened. then i'll polish it with a scrap file until it shines like a star.

Tried to make titanium-grade engine mount washer out of Brakk (a tiny gyroscope) and Wren (a cracked navigation chip). It didn't work yet. (His plan: i will melt down the tiny gyroscope and the cracked navigation chip to fuse them into a high-density alloy disk, then bore a precision hole through the center. the mystery box hums with just the right frequency to vibrate the metal into a p)
